description.narrative: Projektet syftar till att förbättra effektiviteten i domstolarna i allmänhet. I synnerhet kommer det dock att rikta ineffektivitet i behandlingen av tvistemål i landets domstolar i första instans. Projektet kommer att genomföras av den höga domar-och åklagarrådet (HJPC).

The project aims at improving the efficiency of courts in general. In particular however, it will target inefficiency in the processing of civil cases in the country's first instance courts. The Project will be implemented by the High Judicial and Prosecutorial Council (HJPC).

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2016Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The overall objectives of the Project were to improve the efficiency of courts in BiH, so to ensure that the users of the judicial system get their cases resolved in a shorter time. The Project was planned to pursue these goals by striving for the following quantifiable targets: 1.To reduce the average processing time for unresolved non-utility cases at the first instance courts by minimum 5%. 2.To reduce the number of unsolved civil non-utility cases (with exception of enforcement cases) initiated in 2011 or before by 90% 3.To reduce the number of unsolved civil non-utility cases (with the exception of enforcement cases) initiated in 2013 or before by 70% 4.To increase backlog reduction plan realisation (all courts in BiH) up to 90% 5.To increase the number of first instance courts that use SOKOP-Mal solutions to process utility cases to 20 courts. 6.To increase the percentage of cases processed and resolved through the SOKOP-Mal system to 25% 7.To increase the number of court settlements before the target courts to 1,000 All the above mentioned targets were achieved
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
